usedFor: Razorpay holds your payments, and Google Chat warns your team through “Send Message” when one fails.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Fails” in Razorpay, then “Send Message” in Google Chat
bestTemplate.why: A failed payment posts to a Google Chat space, so someone can follow up the same day.

watchOut: “Payment Fails” in Razorpay is pushed, but refunds need their own “A New Refund Is Created” template.
